submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on a token that completes a tightly constrained local frame licensed by its immediate left context: a hyphen joining a year range or compound name, a contraction tail after an apostrophe, or a subject pronoun or finite verb resuming a clause after a complementizer or antecedent noun. The same category of token without that licensing left context (a comma for the hyphen, they for that-he, a full-word have for clitic ve) stays near zero.

top_examples.text:
No fixed monetary value could ever fully appraise the value of healthy, unfettered human mobility. And at the core of healthy mobility are strong, functional, well-lubricated joint structures. This, sadly, is not the reality known to a fair majority of aging adults. As we age, a lifetime of shock and impact unsuspectingly takes its toll on the cartilage that cushions us. Factor in poor nutrition, insufficient stretching, and poor exercise habits, and the situation becomes even more complicated. Flexibility becomes limited, discomforts grow more recognizable, and the simple task of getting from point A to B becomes an ever-increasing challenge.
Hope, however, is not lost. There are a number of chondro-protective agents and nutrients available that have been shown to provide joint structures with the vital components needed for the support of healthy, normalized mobility. “Glucosamine and Chondroitin are among the most significant, as they work by providing the raw material necessary to produce and maintain new cartilage, respectively.” Other chondro-protective nutrients and herbs, including Cetyl Myristoleate, MSM, Boswellin®, Celadrin®, and Hyaluronic Acid, work synergistically with glucosamine and chondroitin to further support normal joint function.*
The key element in human joints is articular cartilage, the shock-absorbing tissue that connects two bones together. Articular cartilage is comprised of two different molecules, collagen and proteoglycans, with the remainder composed primarily of water (65-85%). Collagen, a protein that binds tissue together, provides elasticity. Proteoglycans, composed of sugars and protein, absorb water, which provides lubrication and resiliency, nature’s shock absorber for your joints. Both compounds are produced by chondrocytes, caretaker cells responsible for the formation and maintenance of cartilage.
A deficiency in any one of the above constituents will increase the likelihood of wear and tear on articular cartilage, which can eventually lead to compromised joint function.

备的。对于那些想快速考过雅思或者PTE的同学，这里不太合适他们。因为图南从英文的基础一点一点开始重新教授，需要花费的时间比较长。如果把英文培训比作盖房子，那么图南是从地基开始，而其他机构可能只是从搭建上层结构，甚至是从装修，开始的。
在Level 1 的时候，我学的很迷茫，整天找一级结构，这与其它的雅思机构教的完全不同，甚至没有涉及到任何的考试内容。而在Level 2 又是找不到"Move"和"Jump“。直到到了Level 3，我才知道原来李老师的理论是这么伟大。一级结构是句子内部的关系，而”move”和”jump”是句与句的关系。再加上Level 3 练习的”三板斧”，合起来正好是英文表达所需要的逻辑。当所有这些都收集并掌握了，就可以召唤神龙了。
这是写作方面的，而在口语方面，李老师给我们着重训练复述的能力。一句话说的抑扬顿挫都错了，那么这句话是什么意思肯定理解错了。通过断句、重音和升降调，其实是完整的把一个句子的结构给“说”出来。至此，我才反应过来之前对英文写作和口语的理解实在是太肤浅了。
我真的很感谢图南的每位老师，李想老师，思思老师，晶晶老师（着重强调T_T），Rachel老师，Emma老师，Jerry老师，还有已经离开的Juliet老师和薛俊老师。正是图南和每位老师把我从我的人生低谷中拯救了出来。在来图南之前，我自闭、抑郁、对自己感到失望，因为雅思考了一年多依然考不过，对自己的未来十分担心。但是正是图南的每位老师让我看到了希望，也让我重新回到正轨，走出阴霾。除此之外，李老师还帮了我一个大忙，就是让我的逻辑得到了很大的提升。在过去几年里我一直没办法用母语表达清楚我想要说的话，哪怕是我有理有据也不会说。这让我很痛苦。通过跟李老师学习英文的逻辑，我发现原来世界上所有的语言逻辑都是大同小异的，学习英文的同时也让我的中文进步了不少。这个算是bonus吧。最后，我想对所有还在考雅思的同学们说一句，勤能补拙，并且掌握方式方法很重要。
PS：Emma老师有句“必过”
